thesis: The episode discusses Chris Dixon's new book, 'Read Write Own,' which argues that blockchain is the credible way to restore the open, democratic nature of the internet for building and entrepreneurship. The conversation also covers the book's themes regarding intersecting technologies like AI and social networks, as well as the author's 20-year career perspective on internet economics and governance.
